title: secret-stores (koorikla)
description: Platform keys only; cluster.* and installation keys stay open. Cross-field and tenant-isolation rules: templates/validate.yaml.

role.description: Cluster role from the ApplicationSet: mgmt renders the platform stores, anything else the workload stores.

secrets.description: Secret backend of the installation (installation.yaml secrets.*).

namespaces.description: Namespaces allowed to read store platform (never workflows-*: templates/validate.yaml).

workflowStore.description: ClusterSecretStore workflows (key-scoped, for workflow run namespaces).

keys.description: Secret keys store workflows may read.

namespaceRegexes.description: Namespaces allowed to read store workflows: workflow run namespaces only.

dnsStore.description: ClusterSecretStore dns (the Cloudflare token, dns.provider cloudflare).

namespaces.description: Namespaces allowed to read store dns.

repoCreds.description: Argo CD repo-creds ExternalSecret on mgmt.

auth.description: token (username + token) or githubApp (App ID, installation ID, private key); empty: token.

previewToken.description: GitHub token of the PR preview ApplicationSets (ESO GithubAccessToken).

secretName.description: Secret name of the minted token (the App credentials go to <secretName>-app).

permissions.description: GitHub App token permissions (least privilege: pull_requests: read).
